$comment: Copy to iterata.config.json in the project you are designing. Every field is optional; the values below are the defaults plus the two that are worth setting for any real site (hideOnFullPage and sections).
$routes: Routes to capture, each crossed with every theme. Defaults to ["/"]. An entry is a path string, or { "path": "/x", "name": "slug" } when you want to name the capture files yourself. The root route contributes no prefix, so a single-route project gets the same filenames it always had; every other route prefixes its slug, e.g. da-desktop-dark-full.jpg.
$themes: Themes to capture, in order. The first is the primary and gets the hero shot, the section crops, the mobile shot and the reduced-motion shot; the rest get a full-page shot only. A site with one theme should list only that theme, otherwise the rig shoots the same page twice under two names. Only "light" and "dark" are accepted.
$themeStorageKey: localStorage key the theme switcher reads, seeded before load so shots are deterministic. next-themes uses "theme". Set to null on a site with no theme switcher.
$hideOnFullPage: CSS selectors for position:fixed elements. They repeat down a fullPage capture, so they are hidden for those shots only. A selector that matches nothing prints a warning rather than failing silently.
$sections: Element ids captured as individual crops during the full rig.
$timing: scrollStep is in pixels, everything else in milliseconds. maxScrollPasses bounds the scroll walk so an infinite-scroll page cannot spin forever; iterata warns when it hits the cap.
